analysis.analysis: 'A Total Axial Negation Graph (TANG) is a post-structuralist academic-architectural genre used to map complex theoretical fields (such as labor, cybernetics, or gender theory). In this framework, a central thesis is surrounded by exhaustive citations to ensure that no single school of thought can claim intellectual dominance.' (Zenodo +1) Expanded — 'TANGs typically follow specific structural guidelines:' 'The Void: Placed at the center of the graph, this represents a falsifiable thesis or concept that the surrounding schools of thought approach but cannot fully liquidate into representation.' (Zenodo +1) 'The Perimeter: Contains nodes (thinkers, texts, or schools) that are arranged symmetrically or axially around the void, illustrating how each negates or circumvents the central thesis.'
